attributes.description: towering, jagged mountain peak with sheer granite face, partially illuminated by golden light, casting warm amber and orange highlights on snow-covered ridges and rocky outcrops

traditional Norwegian 'rorbuer' clustered along a rocky jetty, small with steep gabled roofs, some painted vibrant red with white trim, others in softer red tone, arranged in a row along a wooden pier extending into the water
rugged, snow-dusted shoreline with foreground rocks covered in snow, contrasting with dark, wet stone and glowing warmth of the setting sun
sea captured with long exposure, waves as silky, flowing ribbons of turquoise and gray, gently lapping against rocks
dramatic gradient from soft pink and lavender near the horizon to deep purples and grays higher up, with scattered clouds catching last rays of sunlight
